description:
List agent harnesses: coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, goose, Cline, Aider...) and agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, smolagents, Mastra, LangGraph).

Use when: the user is choosing a coding agent or agent framework by licence, interface, model support or features. For one harness use get_harness.

Behavior: Read-only. Per harness: maker, interface, licence, GitHub stars with date, models, official pricing with source and date, and docs-verified features (MCP, subagents, headless, sandboxing). null means not stated or not verified, never 'no'.

Example: {"kind":"coding agent","open_source":true,"mcp":true}

byo_model.description: true = only harnesses documented to accept your own model/provider.

interface.description: Interface prefix, e.g. CLI, IDE, desktop, SDK.

mcp.description: true = only harnesses with documented MCP support.

open_source.description: true = only open source; false = only not open source.

q.description: Substring match on name, maker or description.

name: list_harnesses
title: List agent harnesses
